bootstrap_note: The H/Z TVD interval resamples ROOT ntuple_file_index clusters independently within class.
claim_boundary: These figures test association between a frozen classifier score and the reco helicity-angle proxy in selected simulated reco 1p0n x 1p0n events. They do not establish that the classifier learned or used spin, nor that an H/Z shape difference is spin-only.

definition.clipping: none; out-of-range raw angles are counted outside the primary map
definition.collinear_equation: MET_T = alpha_minus pT_vis_minus + alpha_plus pT_vis_plus; z=1/(1+alpha); E_tau=E_vis/z
definition.collinear_valid: finite alpha,z; |sin(dphi)|>1e-6; alpha>=0; 0<z<=1 on both sides
definition.e_pi: unique selected charged track with charged-pion mass hypothesis
definition.map_population: collinear valid, finite raw angle, and both raw |cos(theta)|<=1
definition.score: H-like score from frozen full-reco arithmetic ensemble of seeds 42, 43, 44 at terminal checkpoints

inclusive_h_z_tvd.cluster_unit: ntuple_file_index sampled independently within truth class
inclusive_h_z_tvd.interval_method: cluster bootstrap, distribution centered on the plug-in estimate
inclusive_h_z_tvd.rationale: 2000 replicates matches the frozen classifier comparison. The centered interval reports cluster-resampling spread without presenting the known upward plug-in bias of sparse-bin TVD as a displacement of the point estimate.

within_class_score_permutation.rationale: 1000 within-class permutations give 0.001 tail-probability resolution for a minimum visual null control; no significance claim is made.

identity_join.event_number_caveat: source_event_number is diagnostic and non-unique, so it is never used as a join key
identity_join.processed_to_sidecar: the processed-shard builder and prediction sidecar share the frozen validation row-map order; all sample_id, label, and source_event_number rows are required to agree before identities are attached
identity_join.semantics: ensemble scores are joined by unique complete ROOT identity key sets; missing, duplicate, or label-mismatched rows fail closed, and ensemble input row order is not used

limitations: No processed-tensor truth pi-nu purity or truth-to-reco angular response is available.
No additional parent pT-|eta| overlap weighting is applied.
Truth-class conditioning removes overall H/Z mixture changes, not within-class kinematics, acceptance, reconstruction, MET, collinear-quality, or direct classifier-input dependence.
Class-specific score tertiles are within-class ranks and are not a common operating threshold.
A shuffled-score map is a visual association null, not a kinematic deconfounder.

lineage.comparison_claim_boundary: three-seed ensemble AUC ordering at the terminal endpoint of the common adaptive-v1 schedule on the held-out report partition; not whole-ROC dominance, asymptotic performance, retraining uncertainty, causal attribution or a spin fraction

permutation_note: The low-high TVD null shuffles scores only within truth class and the fixed track-audited cohort.

population.weights: unit weight; no additional parent-overlap weight

primary_estimand: unit-weight nominal shape in the held-out report subset of the fixed-v3 pT-matched validation surface

selection.charged_track: exactly one core && passTrkSelector track per tau, with tau[0]/tau[1] charges -1/+1
selection.decay_mode: both reconstructed taus raw decay-mode code 0 (processed categorical id 1)
selection.score_tertile_population: report subset, reco 1p0n x 1p0n, unique charge-ordered track pair; before collinear validity
selection.score_tertile_rule: within truth class, unit weight: s<=q1; q1<s<=q2; q2<s
selection.tau_side_convention: tau[0] = tau-; tau[1] = tau+, audited by selected track charge
